Esha Tewari is an Australian singer-songwriter. She released the EPs I Can, Better Off, Wraith, and What Makes A Girl. She is the opening act on Conan Gray's Wishbone tour.
Early life
Tewari was born in Australia to a mother of north Indian descent, from Gangtok, Sikkim, and a father of English descent. She started playing violin at the age of 4, and then picked up piano and received singing lessons in her early teens. Tewari began writing songs in her bedroom at 17--teaching herself guitar and production--and sharing songs on social media.
Career
Tewari posted covers and original songs on TikTok in late 2023, releasing her debut single "With Ease" in early 2024. She followed up with the release of the single "Beautiful Boy", originally shared as a voice memo on TikTok, which went viral and was later released on her debut EP, I Can in 2024. Her second EP, Better Off, was released in August 2024, and she performed at SXSW Sydney in October 2024.
Tewari headlined her first national tour in 2024. In January 2025, Tewari signed with Warner Music in collaboration with Atlantic Records. She completed a sold-out Australian tour in the spring of 2025, followed by her North American "Wraith Tour" the same year.
Tewari released her third EP, Wraith, in May 2025. In October 2025, she was announced as a special guest on Conan Gray's 2026 Wishbone World Tour which plays in North America, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. Tewari released the single "In Twos" in November 2025, followed by her fourth EP, What Makes A Girl, in December 2025.
What Makes A Girl was followed  with a deluxe edition, What Makes A Girl A Girl with two extra songs, "Cars and Gasoline" and "Where Our Streets Meet".
Musical style
Tewari's music style is described as indie folk, pop, and indie pop.
